DNA quantification and DNA quality evaluation: Measure DNA with a fluorometric assay such as Qubit (Invitrogen) or Quantus (Promega), then measure with a spectrophotometer like Nanodrop and observer the 260/280, 260/230 ratios and concentration. Ideally, the pure DNA should have a 260/280, 1.8 and, 260/230, 2.0 and the concentration measured by both fluorometric assay and spectrophotometer 1:1 or 1:1.2. steps.title: Pre‑warm extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Set a water bath to 60 °C, add 1 % (v/v) polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) to the CTAB lysis buffer, and keep the buffer in the water bath to pre‑warm for 10 min.

steps.title: Pre‑chill mortar, pestle, sand
steps.instruction: Weigh 200 mg acid‑washed autoclaved sand per 100 mg tissue, place the sand in a clean sterile mortar, add liquid nitrogen, and let it dissipate for 5 min.

steps.title: Add spores to mortar
steps.instruction: Weigh 100 mg spores, add them to the mortar as the last drop of liquid nitrogen dissipates, and mix the tissue with sand using the pestle before adding more liquid nitrogen (5 min).

steps.title: Grind spores with liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Grind the spores/tissue 3–4 times, each for ~10 s, adding liquid nitrogen each time; avoid excessive pressure to prevent shearing DNA (3 min).

steps.title: CTAB lysis and Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Aliquot 5 mL CTAB lysis buffer into a 50 mL Falcon tube, add the ground tissue, rotate on a tube rotator for 10 min to homogenize, then add 50 µL Proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹) and incubate on the rotator at room temperature for 1.5 h.

steps.title: First chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add one volume (5 mL) chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1) to the tube, rotate for 15 min, then centrifuge at room temperature for 15 min at 5 000 g.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 50 mL tube, add 5 µL RNase T (1000 U µL⁻¹), and incubate on the rotator at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Second chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add one volume (5 mL) chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1), mix until the aqueous phase becomes cloudy, rotate for 15 min, and centrifuge at room temperature for 15 min at 5 000 g.

steps.title: CTAB precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 mL tube, add two volumes of CTAB precipitation buffer, invert to mix, and incubate in a rotating oven set to 55 °C for 30 min until white CTAB‑DNA crystals are visible.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 16 000 g for 5 min at room temperature, then carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of pellet
steps.instruction: Add ~5 mL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, invert the tube several times, and let the pellet soak for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 16 000 g for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Air‑dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet for 10–15 min (or until ethanol evaporates), dissolve the pellet in 200 µL TE buffer by tapping the tube, and transfer the solution to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: SPRI bead purification
steps.instruction: Purify the crude DNA using homemade SPRI paramagnetic beads: first add 2 volumes of bead suspension to the DNA solution, mix, then add 1–0.9 volumes of bead suspension for a second wash; follow the bead protocol for ~40 min to remove impurities, short oligonucleotides, and RNA.
